changes.comment: AHP HR8a: new @grackle-ai/ahp-transport package with WebSocket + JSON-RPC 2.0 framing primitive (JsonRpcSession / AhpServerSocket / AhpClientSocket / ClientIdStore / exponentialBackoff). No consumers wired yet — paves the way for HR8b (MultiHostClient), HR8c (IHostTransport abstraction), and HR8d (the wire flip). Also exposes JsonRpcErrorCodes + AhpErrorCodes from @grackle-ai/ahp (small additive re-export the vendored constants weren't visible to consumers before).
